ESTM.name: Estimated
ESTM.definition: Estimated amount (the final amount could be above or below).

MAXI.name: Maximum
MAXI.definition: Maximum amount (the final amount must be less or equal).

PRXY.name: Proxy
PRXY.definition: Substitute for an amount to be authorised.

RESD.name: Reserved
RESD.definition: Reserved or updated reserved amount for reservation.
